title: When ten scheduled runs produce zero scientific comparisons
decision: Treat the terminal jobs as process-invalid, make no JEPA-over-language-model claim for the easier domain, and admit no new experiment while current work and budget are unresolved.
plain_summary: Seven geometry jobs and two counterfactual jobs failed before training produced usable evidence; a third counterfactual job has no terminal summary, so the scientific question remains open.
